Three concrete residue nonsquare conclusions with explicit Fact prime modulus. Primality certificate binding, actual curve torsion enumeration, finite curve cardinality, native and full Transfer remain open.

Exact cardinality 8*r follows for an explicit finite additive group from kernel cardinality 8, base-point order r, odd image, and affine upper bound. Concrete curve instantiation and discharge of those premises, native and full Transfer remain open.

Two small additive group theorems: a nonzero eight-image two-torsion point lifts to order16; absence of order16 implies odd eight-image cardinality by Cauchy. Actual curve order16 exclusion, torsion enumeration and concrete binding, native and full Transfer remain open.

Every square-equation fibre in an explicit finite field has at most two solutions. Arbitrary Y-square affine solution sets have at most 2*card(field), and adjoining the point at infinity adds one. Exact curve equation/point-set binding, torsion/cardinality/native/full Transfer remain open.

For an explicit finite additive commutative group, homomorphism composition kernels satisfy a product bound; a doubling kernel of at most2 implies the kernel of2^k has at most2^k elements, including8. Concrete two-torsion classification, eight-point lower bound/exhaustiveness, native and full Transfer remain open.

Closed actual modulus primality, concrete Euler nonsquares, nonzero B, discriminant scaling and Y=0 algebra for A40962/B-40964. No assumed prime fact in final conclusions. Actual Point two-torsion classification, exhaustive eight-torsion/halves, curve cardinality, native and full Transfer remain open.
